test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Complete the sentence by choosing an appropriate word from the given options.

He has not _______ returned the money
solution:
The correct answer is '**yet'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adverb "**yet**" is commonly used in negative sentences to indicate that something has not happened up to the present moment.
 
• It is placed at the end of the sentence or clause.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He has not **yet**__ returned the money."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "still"** is incorrect because it is not used in this context in negative sentences.
 
• **Option 2: "only"** is incorrect as it does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "too"** is incorrect because it implies excessiveness, which does not fit the context here.
